chain: The Final Message to the Wildhammer

summary: At Revantusk Village, Otho Moji'ko sends you west with a blood-soaked spear bound in gryphon feathers. The Wildhammer dwarves will find it planted beside the well at Aerie Peak's heart.

sections.title: A Spear for Aerie Peak
sections.body: After Another Message to the Wildhammer, Otho Moji'ko gives you a spear soaked in blood and bound with gryphon feathers. Carry it west to Aerie Peak and plant it beside the well at the town's heart. The Wildhammer dwarves will see that the trolls mean business. Furious dwarves and rowdy Alliance folk await you there, and Otho hopes you return alive.

sections.title: Otho's Hope
sections.body: Otho wonders how the dwarves will react when they see the spear. He wishes he could have seen their faces. Are they packing their bags to leave town? For carrying out the deed, Otho promises you the big mojo.

faq.q: Who sends you to plant the spear?
faq.answer: Otho Moji'ko sends you from Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Where must the spear be planted?
aliases: where do i place the spear
faq.answer: Plant the spear beside the well at the heart of Aerie Peak, in the west of the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What is the final message made of?
faq.answer: The final message is a spear soaked in blood and bound with gryphon feathers.

faq.q: What came before this in the chain?
faq.answer: Another Message to the Wildhammer came first. Otho called for gryphon feathers to make this final message.
